CHAPTER 2
Seasons declared, then honoured.

Rather than fiddle with each night, define four broad seasons and let the studio carry the pricing forward. Overrides apply where the calendar requires — an exhibition opening, a regional holiday, the long quiet of February — held in the calendar above.

SEASONS
Four moods, plotted across the year.
SEASON	WINDOW	NIGHTLY RATE	MINIMUM STAY	CHANNELS	RESTRICTION
Low — Stillness	10 Jan — 14 Mar	€240	2 nights	Direct, Studio	None
Shoulder — Spring	15 Mar — 30 May	€280	2 nights	Direct, Studio	Open
High — Summer	1 Jun — 8 Sep	€340	3 nights	Direct, Studio	Sat-only check-in
Low — Deep Winter	20 Dec — 6 Jan	€420	4 nights	Direct	Holiday close-out

CHAPTER 3
Distributed, but never duplicated.

When you publish, the calendar pushes outward in three minutes — to the direct booking engine on Airbnb, to the partner channels you've opted into, and to your private referral list. We remove a small overhead per channel where it matters, never above 4 percent.
